MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of 12
January 2026 between HARBORVIEW HEALTH SYSTEMS, a nonprofit health system
organized under the laws of Ohio ("Harborview"), and TRELLIS DATA PARTNERS,
INC., a Delaware corporation ("Trellis"), in connection with discussions
regarding a potential data-analytics services engagement (the "Purpose").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. "Confidential Information" means any
non-public technical, business, financial, or operational information
disclosed by either Party, whether orally or in writing, in connection with
the Purpose, excluding information that is or becomes publicly available
through no fault of the receiving Party, was already known to the receiving
Party without obligation of confidentiality, or is independently developed
without use of the disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

2. OBLIGATIONS. Each Party shall use the other Party's Confidential
Information solely for the Purpose, shall not disclose it to any third
party without prior written consent, and shall protect it using at least
the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential information, and
no less than reasonable care.

3. TERM. This Agreement's confidentiality obligations survive for three (3)
years from the date of disclosure of the relevant Confidential Information.

4. RETURN OF MATERIALS. Upon written request by the disclosing Party, the
receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information within
thirty (30) days.

5. NO LICENSE. Nothing in this Agreement grants either Party any license or
right to the other Party's intellectual property beyond the limited purpose
of evaluating the Purpose.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the date
first written above.

For HARBORVIEW HEALTH SYSTEMS             For TRELLIS DATA PARTNERS, INC.
